elements.element: Customer owns all deliverables created for Customer, and Vendor assigns all right, title and interest in them to Customer.
elements.evidence: Section e states that TrueLink “hereby assigns to Client all right, title and interest in the deliverables ... created for Client, which Client shall own.”

elements.element: Customer owns all work product created for Customer, and Vendor assigns all right, title and interest in it to Customer.
elements.evidence: Section e expressly assigns to Client all right, title and interest in the work product of the Support Services created for Client and states that Client shall own it.

elements.element: Vendor retains ownership of its pre-existing intellectual property.
elements.evidence: The retained-rights clause covers only TrueLink’s rights in the Interface. There is no general reservation for all pre-existing TrueLink intellectual property, tools, materials, or technology.

elements.element: Vendor grants Customer a licence to Vendor intellectual property embedded in the deliverables.
elements.evidence: Section e grants Client a licence to “any TrueLink Intellectual Property embedded in such deliverables and work product.”

elements.element: The embedded Vendor IP licence is perpetual.
elements.evidence: The embedded TrueLink IP licence is expressly described as perpetual.

elements.element: The embedded Vendor IP licence is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: The embedded TrueLink IP licence is expressly described as irrevocable.

elements.element: The embedded Vendor IP licence is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: The embedded TrueLink IP licence is expressly described as royalty-free.

elements.element: Customer retains all rights in Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Section e states that Client retains all right, title and interest in all data provided by or on behalf of Client or generated through Client’s use of the Interface. The Section 8(d) licence is preserved but does not transfer ownership.

elements.element: No joint ownership of intellectual property is created.
elements.evidence: Section e expressly states: “No joint ownership of any intellectual property is created by this Agreement.”
TrueLink expressly retains rights only in the Interface. The clause does not reserve ownership of generic tools generally.
The rendered clause contains no ownership reservation for TrueLink know-how.

elements.element: Vendor grants Customer a licence covering the deliverables.
elements.evidence: Client receives the stronger remedy of ownership of the deliverables, together with a licence to embedded TrueLink IP. This substantively provides licensed access to the complete deliverables, although it does not use the fallback’s precise licensing structure.

elements.element: The Customer’s rights in the deliverables are perpetual.
elements.evidence: The assignment of ownership has no time limit, and the licence covering embedded TrueLink IP is expressly perpetual.

elements.element: The Customer’s rights in the deliverables are irrevocable.
elements.evidence: The ownership assignment is not revocable, and the licence covering embedded TrueLink IP is expressly irrevocable.
The embedded TrueLink IP licence contains no express worldwide territorial scope. The separate worldwide Credit Data licence runs from Client to TrueLink and does not satisfy this requirement.

elements.element: The Customer’s rights in the deliverables are royalty-free.
elements.evidence: Client owns the deliverables, and the licence to embedded TrueLink IP is expressly royalty-free.

elements.element: Customer may use the deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: The assignment of all right, title and interest permits Client to use the deliverables, and the embedded IP licence contains no business-use restriction.

elements.element: Customer may modify the deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: Although ownership supports modification of Client-owned portions, the licence to embedded TrueLink IP does not expressly grant modification or derivative-work rights, so the right does not demonstrably cover the complete deliverables.

elements.element: Customer may sublicense the deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: The licence to embedded TrueLink IP does not grant sublicensing rights. Ownership of other portions does not supply authority to sublicense embedded TrueLink IP.

result.reason: The redline meets most of the preferred position, including assignment and ownership of deliverables and work product, the perpetual/irrevocable/royalty-free embedded-IP licence, Customer Data ownership, and exclusion of joint ownership. It omits a general reservation of TrueLink’s pre-existing IP, addressing only the Interface, so the preferred level is incomplete. The fallback is also incomplete because generic tools and know-how are not reserved and the embedded-IP licence lacks express worldwide, modification, and sublicensing rights. The existing Interface ownership and Credit Data licence are preserved, but the drafting leaves ambiguity between Client’s ownership of complete deliverables and TrueLink’s retained embedded IP. Because no complete level is reached and broader Client IP ownership is added without curing the key omission, the redline is not minimal.
